symptoms.question: Does the car feel like it slips out of gear or revs rise without speed increasing? (yes/no)
Do you notice a burning smell like clutch material? (yes/no)
Is it difficult to shift gears (hard to engage gears)? (yes/no)
Do you hear whining or grinding noises from the transmission area? (yes/no)

rules.diagnosis: Gear slipping with a burning smell suggests a slipping clutch.
rules.advice: Avoid driving if possible. Continued driving can cause complete clutch failure. Book a repair urgently.

rules.diagnosis: Gear slipping can indicate clutch wear or transmission problems.
rules.advice: Drive gently and have the clutch/transmission inspected soon.

rules.diagnosis: Difficulty shifting can indicate clutch adjustment issues, linkage problems, or transmission wear.
rules.advice: Avoid forcing gears and book an inspection to prevent further damage.

rules.diagnosis: Whining or grinding noises from the transmission can indicate low fluid or internal wear.
rules.advice: Limit driving and have transmission fluid level and condition checked. Continued driving may cause major damage.
